An integrity judge read the earlier note as turning copy_sync_check into a tautology, and the reading is fair as far as it goes. What this file is FOR is the strings a reader receives, and reading them off the render is the only way to get those; what it cannot do is see a string a drawing has painted over, which is the defect that judge found on frame 3 and which no DOM-reading gate in this suite can see. That is a gap in the SUITE and it is written up as one, rather than answered by retyping this file from the plan and calling the disagreement a check.

S1.headline: Texas already had the power to ask.
strings: Texas already had the power to ask.
The Texas Water Code already requires a complete and accurate water use survey.

strings: OFFICE OF THE TEXAS GOVERNOR SEPTEMBER 14TH, 2026
"A data center that fails to complete and return the survey commits an offense punishable as a crime."
"A data center that fails to timely complete and return the survey is ineligible for TCEQ permits, amendments, or renewals under Chapter 11 of the Texas Water Code."

S4.kicker: What the audit is a condition on
S4.headline: The audit rides on the queue.
strings: The audit rides on the queue.
An August 3rd directive ordered an audit of all data centers that advance through the grid operator's interconnection process.
What the audit is a condition on

S5.headline: Three bodies, one answer.
strings: The Texas Water Development Board's Executive Administrator authorized ERCOT to ask on the board's behalf.
THE WATER BOARD authorizes the asking
THE GRID OPERATOR asks on its behalf

S6.headline: The plan needs a number.
strings: The release states the board writes the state water plan and can't do that while it is denied detail on existing and anticipated water consumption.

S7.headline: The board reports back by October 14th.
strings: The board reports back by October 14th.
The board must refer noncompliance to the appropriate County or District Attorney.

S8.headline: The answer is due October 12th.
strings: A complete response carries a notarized attestation from the data center developer.

S9.headline: The grid operator's report is expected in December.
strings: The grid operator's report is expected in December.
Answers are due at 5 p.m. Central Prevailing Time on October 12th.
